title: Re-dispatch prompts when re-naming the selected claim clears a capture hold
outcome: When an explicit name clears or supersedes a pending capture hold, queued ordinary and human prompts resume through the existing dispatch owners without requiring an unrelated later trigger.
acceptance: A behavior test queues a successor behind an unresolved naming predecessor, re-names the already-selected claim to clear that choice, and observes queued dispatch without another user send, mailbox wake or manual test dispatch; ordinary ownership and capture guards remain unchanged.
